[b] UPDATES: [/b]
Hello gamers,

As we actively continue the development of Escape the Escape Rooms we are pleased to announce that development is going well. We will now be operating full development as normal now as the festive holidays have passed. 

Please continue adding this to your wishlists and please keep your eyes peeled for a sneaky trailer soon before release. Remember and join our dedicated discord for updates.
